page.title: POSTAL 1997 loading screen effect
page.sub:
Recreation based on the POSTAL 1997 source code released by Running With Scissors on GitHub (cutscene.cpp and play.cpp).
This is a fan project, not official from the Running with Scissors team.
upload.bg.tip: Only changes the preview background, to test how the effect would look somewhere else. The image with the effect is not exported with the background: it is purely cosmetic.
postal.info: Original values, not editable: full spin every 3600 ms, maximum separation of 24 px between the two copies, 10 s cycle (they move out, spin and come together for 5 s, then stay still and together for another 5 s), opacity 0.5, roughly 15 fps, whole degrees and pixels, and the effect applied to the whole image.
link.free: Get POSTAL for Free on Steam
modal.title: Save as MP4
q.high.info: Upscaled to 1080 px or more, sharper and heavier.
ctl.z: Preview size (% of the original, max. 100)
ctl.ov: When the effect goes past the image edge
ctl.ov.out: Let it spill out (transparent over the background)
ctl.rest: Rest: copies together for half a turn of the cycle
tip.n: How many images are stacked. With 2 it is the original effect: one opaque copy and one transparent.
tip.A: How transparent the copies look. Lower is more subtle.
tip.Rp: How far apart the copies get at the peak of the cycle, as a percentage of the image width. In the game it is 3.75%.
tip.sp: Spin speed. At 1 it matches the game (one turn every 3.6 s). A negative value reverses the direction.
tip.C: How long a full cycle of the copies moving out and back takes. In the game it is 10 s.
tip.F: Frames per second of the effect and of the exported video. The original game runs at about 15.
tip.rot: How much the copies tilt while they spin. At 0 they do not tilt.
tip.zm: Size of the copies relative to the image. 1 is the same size; larger or smaller values enlarge or shrink them.
tip.P: Infinite loop repeats the effect nonstop. Start and end plays it once and then stays still.
tip.bl: How the copies blend with the image. Normal is the game's; the others give light effects.
tip.rest: The copies stay together and still for half a turn of the cycle, as in the original. If you turn it off, they never stop.
tip.int: Moves the copies in whole pixels and degrees, like the game, which gives it its stepped look.
st.savefail: Could not save. Use the Download button.
